newsitem.title: USA: Fed approves U.S. banks' proposal on funds network.
newsitem.headline: Fed approves U.S. banks' proposal on funds network.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Reserve said Monday that it approved notices by six Southeast banks to acquire more than 5 percent of the voting shares in a company that will result from merging three electronic funds transfer networks.
The joint venture company will bring together the funds networks called HONOR, MOST and ALERT.

The banks taking shares in the new company are Barnett Banks Inc of Jacksonville, Fla, Crestar Financial Corp of Richmond, Va, First Union Corp and NationsBank Corp, both of Charlotte, N.C., and Southern National Corp and Wachovia Corp, both of Winston-Salem, N.C.
